content.thinking:
I'm reading the delivery note DN-261110-769, dated 11/10/2026, and weighing whether that's US or German format. The stamp reads 13.11.2026, but the DN number and filename point to 2026-11-10, and with a US supplier the date most likely means November 10.

I'm settling the quantities: the document is in English from a US supplier, but the pieces are whole counts, so "41.200" reads as 41,200 and "5.000" as 5,000. I'll note that ambiguity, then record the package totals, the 198 kg gross weight, and the stamped receipt date with the signature.

I'm wrapping up the line items: the part numbers map to the material ID, and the supplier part number stays blank. The package counts add up to nine, and the two purchase orders aren't mapped to individual lines. I'm adding a totals line for the 198 kg gross weight and the package count, since the weight only appears at header level.

Note date '11/10/2026' is ambiguous between US and German formats. I read it as 10 Nov 2026, in line with the DN number (261110) and the received stamp of 13.11.2026.
Blue received stamp with handwritten signature 'Meyer K.' is clear.
Package counts per line (8 + 1) match the stated total of 9.
